participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Kept the hour on the music, withheld the price and the introduction, and sent the room out.

story.body: You sat in the room while the virginals went through a strain exact and then faster. Morley talked of five voices at the printer's, and of strings he would not price. You said you knew the hand, and you asked not to be made known. She did not speak. You left with the sound and without a name, inside the half-hour.

story.body: You spoke about the jacks and the hand, said there was no name to ask, and stopped before any verse.

story.body: You set down four lines under the date and stopped. There is no name, no number, and no title on the leaf.
